assumptions.statement: All event durations are synthetic working minutes and are additive because the AS-IS path is modeled sequentially.
Hourly rates are synthetic comparison inputs and do not represent salary, invoice, or market data.
Wait time does not incur direct labor cost in the baseline calculator.
The 240 instances are sufficient to prove calculator reproducibility, not operational generalization.
Future implementation effort and change risk require labeled human estimates and cannot be derived from event data alone.
